title: CredentialOnFileType
description:
Credential on file type, used with cards in a wallet, if applicable.
- *subscription* - a series of scheduled transactions with a fixed amount (e.g. monthly membership to access a service or application features)
- *recurring* - a series of scheduled transactions with a variable amount (e.g. monthly payments to a utility company where the amount varies depending on usage)
- *unscheduled* - for unscheduled transactions, such as when a cardholder makes unscheduled transactions using the same credentials or when a merchant may need to create unscheduled transactions using a customer's card stored on file.
